The '''Farfalla skyscraper''' was an historic [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] erected just east of the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Presidential Palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==History==
Erected just east of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Presidential Palace]], the Farfalla skyscraper was named after the famed Republic hero of the [[New Sith Wars]], [[Jedi Lord]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]]. Despite its historical status, the skyscraper was razed in the decade before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] of [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], a powerful [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] in the crime syndicate [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. On the footprint of the historic tower, Xizor established a massive [[Xizor's Palace|palace]] that, while dwarfed by the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor's]] palace, towered over the surrounding buildings.<ref name="CATCW" />
